title: KitFlow Index
description: A Fabric client kit stock overlay for totems, crystals, pearls, anchors, and support blocks.
body:
# KitFlow Index

KitFlow Index is a Fabric client kit-stock overlay for modern PvP inventories. It keeps compact counts for the resources players actually burn through in fights: totems, crystals, pearls, anchors, obsidian, glowstone, and mace availability.

It is meant to reduce inventory tunnel vision during fights and practice sessions while staying strictly informational.

## Features

- Counts key PvP supplies across the player inventory
- Low-stock warnings for totems, crystals, pearls, anchors, obsidian, and glowstone
- Optional mace availability line
- Compact mode for smaller screens
- Configurable HUD position, scale, opacity, thresholds, and colors
- Mod Menu config screen

## PvP Fairness

KitFlow Index does not move items, refill hotbars, swap slots, click inventory, select items, or automate combat. It only counts items already in your own inventory and displays the result.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Requires: Fabric API
- Optional: Mod Menu for in-game configuration

## Author

Created by experiment-0011.
